title: Laws and notices
description: Official source documents used in reviews and the status of external API connections.
loadError: Could not load the source status.

indexed.title: Legal search is on
indexed.text: Reviews look up related articles in the loaded sources. Results are statute candidates, not legality rulings.

notIndexed.title: Legal sources not loaded
notIndexed.text: No legal source is loaded yet, so reviews get no legal basis. Restarting docker compose runs rag-ingest automatically; to load by hand run scripts/ingest_rag.py all.

unavailable.title: Legal search service unavailable
unavailable.text: Could not get the index status from the search service. Legal search may fail during reviews.

apiRole.supporting: Available as a tool, not yet called in reviews

note: Keys and approval permissions are checked on the server, and reading the official spec does not mean real responses were verified. Laws and standards are indexed in the knowledge schema (pgvector) for search, while patents and product data are queried live through APIs.
